name: memory
description: Proactive cross-agent project memory and consolidation backed by a track vault.

interface.shortDescription: Recall shared project context before substantial work.
interface.longDescription: Memory proactively recalls project-scoped context from a shared track vault before substantial work, records durable facts for Claude, Codex, and OpenCode, and consolidates duplicates, contradictions, and stale entries with the dream skill.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recall relevant track memory for this project before the task and record any durable facts you learn.
